title: Auto Loans: GAP Waiver Coverage Terms
content:
GAP waiver coverage can be added to an Auto Loans account. This card records whether each product offers it, what the one-time charge is, how long a cancellation earns back the whole charge, the fee kept after that period, and how a partial refund is prorated.

## Coverage terms by product

| Loan product | GAP coverage offered | One-time GAP charge financed at funding (USD) | Full-refund period (calendar days after funding) | Cancellation fee after the full-refund period (USD) | Proration method after the full-refund period |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Used Vehicle Loan | yes | 695.00 | 60 | 50.00 | prorated by remaining term |
| Certified Pre-Owned Vehicle Loan | yes | 695.00 | 60 | 50.00 | prorated by remaining term |
| Auto Refinance Loan | yes | 595.00 | 60 | 50.00 | prorated by remaining term |
| Lease Buyout Loan | yes | 595.00 | 60 | 50.00 | prorated by remaining term |
| New Vehicle Loan | yes | 795.00 | 60 | 50.00 | prorated by remaining term |
| Green Vehicle Loan | yes | 795.00 | 60 | 50.00 | prorated by remaining term |

## How to read the card

- The GAP charge is a single amount, financed as part of the loan on the day it funds.
- The full-refund period is counted in calendar days from funding; a cancellation inside it returns the charge in full.
- After that period the refund is worked out in proportion to the term still remaining, and the cancellation fee shown is deducted from that proportional amount.

## Price comparison

The charge is lowest, 595.00 dollars, on the Auto Refinance Loan and the Lease Buyout Loan; 695.00 dollars on the Used and Certified Pre-Owned Vehicle Loans; and highest, 795.00 dollars, on the New and Green Vehicle Loans. Every product offers the coverage, and the refund period, fee and proration method do not vary.
